title: dump-parse-uses
summary: Diagnostic dump of what the Delphi parser reports for one file's uses clauses and implementation line, without an index
intro: Read this only when debugging uses-clause extraction: dump-parse-uses --file PATH prints implementation_line and one line per uses entry (section, unit, line) straight from the parser -- no preprocess, no database.
notes: internal: diagnostic (N-06): parser uses entries + implementation line for one file, no index. Backs run_parse_implementation_line.ps1.
